lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 오늘 일정 안내를 맡은 김민수입니다.
lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm Kim Minsu, your guide for today's schedule.
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. oneul iljeong annaereul mateun Gim Minsuimnida.
lines.learner: 반갑습니다. 오늘 명승지 세 곳을 가는 게 맞지요?
lines.en: Nice to meet you. We're visiting three scenic spots today, right?
lines.roman: bangapseumnida. oneul myeongseungji se goseul ganeun ge matjiyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 맞습니다. 첫 번째는 산 위 전망대입니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, that's right. The first is the observatory on the mountain.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, matseumnida. cheot beonjjaeneun san wi jeonmangdaeimnida.
lines.learner: 전망대 개방 여부를 알 수 있을까요?
lines.en: Could I find out whether the observatory is open?
lines.roman: jeonmangdae gaebang yeobureul al su isseulkkayo?

lines.beaver: 오늘은 열려 있습니다. 오전 시간대가 한적해요.
lines.beaver_en: It's open today. The morning hours are quiet.
lines.beaver_roman: oneureun yeollyeo itseumnida. ojeon sigandaega hanjeokaeyo.
lines.en: I heard the scenery from there is beautiful.

lines.beaver: 네, 이 일대에서 경관이 가장 좋은 곳입니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it has the best scenery in this area.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, i ildaeeseo gyeonggwani gajang joeun gosimnida.
lines.en: I heard travelers long ago passed through there too.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 그래서 옛 기행 글에도 자주 나옵니다.
lines.beaver_en: Right. That's why it often appears in old travel writing.
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. geuraeseo yet gihaeng geuredo jaju naomnida.
lines.learner: 저도 이번 여행으로 기행문을 써 보려고 해요.
lines.en: I'm planning to write a travel piece about this trip too.
lines.roman: jeodo ibeon yeohaengeuro gihaengmuneul sseo boryeogo haeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋네요. 두 번째 명승지는 옛 마을입니다.
lines.beaver_en: Nice. The second scenic spot is an old village.
lines.beaver_roman: jonneyo. du beonjjae myeongseungjineun yet maeurimnida.
lines.learner: 그 마을은 이주해 온 사람들이 만든 곳이지요?
lines.en: That village was built by people who migrated there, right?
lines.roman: geu maeureun ijuhae on saramdeuri mandeun gosijiyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 백여 년 전에 많은 사람이 이주해 왔습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, many people moved there over a hundred years ago.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, baegyeo nyeon jeone maneun sarami ijuhae wasseumnida.
lines.en: They must have missed home a lot, living so far away.

lines.beaver: 네, 그래서 고향으로 돌아간 사람도 많았어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, so many people went back to their hometowns.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, geuraeseo gohyangeuro doragan saramdo manasseoyo.
lines.en: They must have struggled over whether to go home.

lines.beaver: 네. 마지막 일정 뒤엔 공항으로 바로 가요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes. After the last stop, we go straight to the airport.
lines.beaver_roman: ne. majimak iljeong dwien gonghangeuro baro gayo.
lines.en: Where at the airport do I make my customs declaration?

lines.beaver: 공항 이 층 세관 사무소입니다. 제가 모셔 갈게요.
lines.beaver_en: It's the customs office on the 2nd floor. I'll take you there.
lines.beaver_roman: gonghang i cheung segwan samusoimnida. jega mosyeo galgeyo.
lines.en: Thank you. I'm really looking forward to today.
